summaryZh: Environmental Fluid Dynamics Lab研究工程与海洋流动问题，重点考察沿海环境中流动结构如何影响湍流混合和物质输运，尺度从岛屿及陆架延伸到珊瑚礁、海带林和波浪边界层。研究结合实验室实验、数值建模与野外观测，并涉及海洋仪器、波浪能及自主载具技术。
researchQuestions: 沿海流动结构如何影响湍流混合和物质输运？

evidence.quote: Research in the Environmental Fluid Dynamics Lab (EFD Lab; PI: G. Pawlak Tejada) addresses engineering and oceanographic fluid flow problems, with a focus on coastal ocean physics.

Our work examines the role of flow structure in turbulent mixing and mass transport in environmental flows at scales ranging from islands, headlands and continental shelves (kilometers) to coral reefs and kelp forests (meters) to wave boundary layers (centimeters).

Research methods combine lab experiments and numerical modeling with field-based observations to address topics that span interaction of flow with biological systems, surface and internal waves, and air-sea and sediment/water-column exchange processes.
Research directions also extend to development of ocean instrumentation, wave energy and autonomous vehicle technologies and applications and lab experimental methods.
Geno Pawlak Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering / Scripps Institution of Oceanography University of California San Diego
